# `vox-speech`

**Crate:** `vox-speech` · **Version:** `0.6.0` · **Target:** Library (`lib.rs`)

Vox speech-to-text (Oratio) — transcript refinement, routing and Sherpa-ONNX STT; Candle Whisper lives in vox-plugin-speech

## Crate Overview

**Oratio** — Vox speech-to-text and transcript refinement.

STT runs through **Sherpa-ONNX** in-process (`stt-sherpa`) or **Candle Whisper** in the
`oratio` plugin (vox-plugin-speech), which hosts register through
[`backend_dispatch::register_whisper_transcriber`]. Audio file decoding needs the
`audio-decode` feature; without it only `.txt` / `.md` passthrough is available.


## Features

| Feature | Default / Enables |
|---|---|
| `audio-decode` | dep:symphonia, dep:rubato |
| `cloud` | dep:vox-populi, dep:tokio, dep:vox-http-client, dep:async-trait, dep:reqwest |
| `compiler-rerank` | dep:vox-compiler |
| `default` | compiler-rerank |
| `serve` | dep:axum, axum/multipart, dep:tokio |
| `stt-sherpa` | dep:sherpa-onnx, dep:hf-hub, audio-decode |
